title: Crispy Fried Spanish Tortas
description: Crispy fried Spanish tortas, a twist on the classic Mexican sandwich. Crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside, topped with savory ingredients.
instructions: Heat lard in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the bread until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the bread from the skillet and set aside.
Add chorizo to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked chorizo to the fried bread.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the chorizo.
Return the bread to the skillet and cook until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
